title: Multi-subproject umbrella init, file-aware hook routing, single-adapter sync, and permission AST lint
what: init recursively initializes independent child repos in umbrella folders (e.g. Fliiper/centinela), PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop resolve hooks to the edited file's .harness root with umbrella prompt handoff, --adapter selects Antigravity/Claude cleanly without triplicating built-in skills, and assumptions.rs flags unchecked Kotlin/JS/TS permission APIs.
why: Prevents 3x adapter bloat, makes hooks and tasks work seamlessly when opening an AI agent at an umbrella workspace root, and blocks unverified permission assumptions at Tier 0.
learned: Ignore hidden dot-directories like .mimocode in stack_detector, keep monorepos under one root .git unified, and inherit parent pending-prompt.json across child subrepos.
author: reactive-end
